blocks.text: From December 5 & 6, 2026, to October 30 & 31, 2027, Klavdij Sluban will be hosting amateur and experienced photographers for workshops in a spacious loft in the heart of Paris, in the 9th arrondissement. Registration for MK is now open.

The spirit of Le Masterklass is: “Show me your photos and I’ll tell you who you are”. Klavdij Sluban is internationally renowned for his journeys ever further east, as well as for his unique work around the world on adolescts in prison, with whom he creates photography workshops.

Le Masterklass is specific in that Klavdij’s individual guidance helps each participant to find their own personal photographic writing. After twelve months, a coherent, sensitive and meaningful body of work is created, in the form of a portfolio and book of a high standard – first and foremost for the participant’s own enjoyment, and subsequently to enter competitions, apply for grants and awards, and to be shown to photography professionals with a view to publication, a book, an exhibition… The cornerstone of the MK is image editing; however, writing texts will also have a prominent position in the project’s development.

In 2026, following several MK sessions, Marco Berti Palazzi was awarded the Escourbiac Prize – Fondation des Treilles, with the publication of a book whilst Camille-Renée Devid exhibited at the Rencontres d’Arles as the winner of the 2025 Portfolio Review.
With one session per month, three take place in a group at the loft in Paris, two are one-to-one in person at the loft in Paris, and seven are held online.
Registration for MK is now open.
